sources.title: Solar Pro 4 model specifications and versions
sources.evidence: Names Solar Pro 4 and snapshot solar-pro4-260806, released August 6, 2026; gives 512K context, English/Korean/Japanese text use, reasoning and tool calling. Explicitly labels parameters undisclosed.

sources.title: Upstage Console changelog
sources.evidence: August 6 entry announces solar-pro4 available. August 11 entry starts paid usage after the free period ended August 10, separating release from later billing and launch publicity.

sources.title: Upstage AI unveils Solar Pro 4
sources.evidence: August 20 press release explicitly describes Solar Pro 4 as a closed commercial LLM and identifies Upstage as its developer.

sources.title: Solar Pro 4 launch article
sources.evidence: Describes API access, 512K context, optional reasoning effort, document and coding tasks, tool calling and OfficeVerse training. Distinguishes Solar Pro 4 from open-weight Solar Open 2 without stating shared parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: Responses API reference
sources.evidence: Explicitly supports solar-pro4 and solar-pro4-260806, rejects non-text input parts, produces text, and documents reasoning and function tools.

sources.title: Generative model comparison
sources.evidence: Current table explicitly labels Solar Pro 4 parameters undisclosed while separately publishing Mini 4, Pro 2 and Mini counts. No active count or architecture is provided for Pro 4.

sources.title: Solar Pro 4 tokenizer model card
sources.evidence: Tokenizer-only repository explicitly contains no model weights or chat template. Its tokenizer license does not establish a license for the closed model.

sources.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report, version 2
sources.evidence: Full technical report discloses 250B total and 15B active parameters and hybrid MoE architecture for Solar Open 2. It contains no Solar Pro 4 reference; those specifications cannot be transferred.

sources.title: Solar Mini 4 launch article
sources.evidence: Later October article discloses Mini 4 total and active counts and MoE structure, but does not disclose Solar Pro 4 size or architecture.

sources.title: Solar Open 2 on aib.vote: final report and Solar Pro 4 testing announcement
sources.evidence: An unaffiliated community user says Solar Pro 4 became available for testing on aib.vote that day. HF API dates the unedited post August 3, 2026. It supplies no exact snapshot identity or confirmation from Upstage.

sources.title: Solar Pro 4 hosted model specifications
sources.evidence: Hosted provider page gives a 524,288-token context and 131,072-token output ceiling; live models API confirms text-to-text. Its August 10 listing date is later than the explicit Upstage release.

sources.title: Solar Mini 4 preview announcement and comparison with Solar Pro 4
sources.evidence: September 14 report calls Solar Pro 4 250B while reporting the Mini 4 preview. This secondary assertion lacks confirmation in examined exact-model primary disclosures and is not adopted as a parameter count.

name.note: Exact official product name; solar-pro4 aliases solar-pro4-260806.

developer.note: Official documentation and the developer announcement identify Upstage.

family.note: Normalized catalog family for the Solar Pro series; the official article compares Pro 4 with Pro 3.

release_date.note: Retain the explicit developer release date, including initial free API access. August 11 is paid usage and launch publicity. The earlier August 3 aib.vote post is an unaffiliated testing claim without a version identifier or developer corroboration, so it remains an unresolved preview lead rather than overriding the documented release.

open_weights.note: Upstage explicitly calls this a closed commercial model and contrasts it with open-weight Solar Open 2. A released tokenizer is not a weight release.

license.note: Descriptive classification supported by the closed commercial API offering; the Upstage Solar License attached to tokenizer files is not a model-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Current exact-model documentation explicitly withholds the count. Checked later Mini 4 documentation, comparison tables, the Solar Open 2 technical report and exact-name architecture/training searches. A secondary Mini 4 article calls Pro 4 250B, but no primary confirmation was found; Solar Open 2 counts are not inherited.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model primary active-parameter count found. The 15B figure belongs to Solar Open 2 and the 3B figure to Mini 4; neither establishes Pro 4 activity.

architecture.note: Official model documentation and training discussion do not disclose Pro 4 network architecture. The Open 2 report has no Pro 4 reference; neither MoE nor dense classification is inferred from related models.

context_window.note: Upstage states 512K; the serving provider explicitly resolves this to 524,288 tokens. The separate 128K output ceiling is not the context window. Direct unauthenticated access to Upstage model metadata returned 401, so that endpoint was not used as evidence.

modalities.note: Exact-model Responses API permits text inputs and text outputs and rejects non-text input parts. Document workflows do not imply native image input.

reasoning.note: Official docs support configurable reasoning effort and reasoning output; it may be disabled by default.

tool_call.note: Exact-model docs explicitly support function tools and tool selection.

description.value: Text model for document analysis, coding and tool-using workflows, with optional reasoning and a 512K-token context window.
description.note: Replaces promotional flagship wording with documented task coverage and capabilities, without asserting undisclosed architecture or size.

patch.description: Text model for document analysis, coding and tool-using workflows, with optional reasoning and a 512K-token context window.

sources.label: Solar Pro 4 model specifications and versions

patch.notes: Upstage documents release on August 6, 2026; paid API usage began August 11. An unaffiliated August 3 testing announcement does not identify the served snapshot. Total and active parameters and model architecture remain undisclosed in exact-model primary sources. Solar Open 2 specifications and the tokenizer license do not apply to this closed model.

summary: Confirmed the official August 6 release, 524,288-token context, text modalities, reasoning and tools. Added the supported proprietary classification and a factual description. Kept architecture and parameter counts null after checking exact-model docs, later comparison material and the related technical report; recorded the uncorroborated earlier testing and secondary 250B leads.
